socfpga_bridge.h

Bridge hardware abstraction driver interface for the SoCFPGA bare-metal software stack.

This header provides legacy, static entry points for controlling the four primary AXI interconnect bridges that connect the HPS and the FPGA fabric.

Note: New development should utilize the handle-based APIs found in `bridge_api.h`, as those interfaces support advanced features like routing configuration, flow-control handshaking, and multi-threaded state management.

enable_hps2fpga_bridge
int32_t enable_hps2fpga_bridge(
void
)

Enables the HPS-to-FPGA (AXI) master bridge.

This bridge provides the HPS with high-bandwidth, memory-mapped access to the FPGA fabric. It is typically used for large-scale data transfers and high-speed communication from the HPS to FPGA-based custom IP cores.  Enabling this bridge activates the AXI master ports and allows transactions from the HPS interconnect into the FPGA memory space.

Returns

0 on success; -EIO if the Secure Interface Platform (SiP) call to the Trusted Firmware/SDM layer fails.

disable_hps2fpga_bridge
int32_t disable_hps2fpga_bridge(
void
)

Disables the HPS-to-FPGA (AXI) master bridge.

Disabling this bridge effectively isolates the FPGA from HPS-originated traffic. This is a critical step during FPGA reconfiguration to prevent illegal bus transactions while the FPGA fabric is inactive or resetting.

Returns

0 on success; -EIO if the SiP call fails.

enable_lwhps2fpga_bridge
int32_t enable_lwhps2fpga_bridge(
void
)

Enables the Light-Weight (LW) HPS-to-FPGA bridge.

Unlike the standard HPS2FPGA bridge, this interface is optimized for low-bandwidth, latency-sensitive control-plane traffic. It is the primary path for the HPS to access FPGA-based configuration registers, status bits, and control state machines.

Returns

0 on success; -EIO if the SiP call fails.

disable_lwhps2fpga_bridge
int32_t disable_lwhps2fpga_bridge(
void
)

Disables the Light-Weight (LW) HPS-to-FPGA bridge.

Returns

0 on success; -EIO if the SiP call fails.

enable_fpga2hps_bridge
int32_t enable_fpga2hps_bridge(
void
)

Enables the FPGA-to-HPS bridge.

This slave bridge allows FPGA-based masters (such as accelerators or custom DMA engines) to initiate transactions directed toward the HPS memory map, including peripheral registers and system-level status blocks.

Returns

0 on success; -EIO if the SiP call fails.

disable_fpga2hps_bridge
int32_t disable_fpga2hps_bridge(
void
)

Disables the FPGA-to-HPS bridge.

Returns

0 on success; -EIO if the SiP call fails.

enable_fpga2sdram_bridge
int32_t enable_fpga2sdram_bridge(
void
)

Enables the FPGA-to-SDRAM bridge.

This provides the FPGA fabric with high-performance, low-latency access directly to the HPS DDR controller. This bridge bypasses the standard system interconnect, providing a direct pipeline for massive data movement, essential for high-throughput applications like frame buffers or signal processing chains.

Returns

0 on success; -EIO if the SiP call fails.

disable_fpga2sdram_bridge
int32_t disable_fpga2sdram_bridge(
void
)

Disables the FPGA-to-SDRAM bridge.

Returns

0 on success; -EIO if the SiP call fails.
